_meta.description: The 'fleet_event' event, one case per kind. Read the kind from 'event'; show 'detail' when present. Unknown kinds must be shown by name, never dropped.

drone_lost.notes: A drone dropped out of the mission. This event carries drone_id and NO detail.

land_all.notes: LAND ALL went out to every link.

land_all_failed.notes: LAND ALL could not be sent to some links; detail names them.

plan_invalidated.notes: The plan was edited on the map after Plan; Start is refused until Plan again.

payload.detail: the plan was edited on the map after Plan; press Plan search again

plan_refused_manual_control.notes: Plan refused while a drone is under manual control.

payload.detail: drone-2 under manual control; press Resume search first

plan_refused_unconnected.notes: Plan refused because a configured drone is not connected (PR #141).

payload.detail: drone-2: not connected. A plan covering the whole area needs every configured drone. Connect the listed drones, or restart the ground with a fleet list containing only the drones that are connected (the launcher does this automatically).

profile_switch_pending.notes: Start was pressed while a detection profile switch is still pending (a warning, not a refusal).

payload.detail: detection profile switch still pending for drone-2; once flying, the edge refuses it and keeps its current profile

retask.notes: The lost drone's lanes were offered to the others. 'to' maps drone id to the number of accepted lanes; 'awaiting' lists offered lanes with no answer yet.

payload.detail: no lanes accepted yet; 2 lanes awaiting drone-1

retask_failed.notes: Lanes nobody can take: every entry has a reason; they also appear in fleet_plan.uncovered.

payload.detail: 2 lanes of drone-1 uncovered: refused by drone-2 (geofence)

start_refused.notes: Start refused; detail names every drone and why.

payload.detail: drone-1: no assign_lanes ack; drone-2: no assign_lanes ack

start_refused_drone_unreachable.notes: A v2 edge refused to take off because it cannot reach its drone.

payload.detail: drone-2: Tello unreachable (no state for 12 s)
